title: The Newton-Muon Optimizer
summary: The Muon optimizer has received considerable attention for its strong performance in training large language models, yet the design principle behind its matrix-gradient orthogonalization remains largely elusive. In this paper, we introduce a surrogate model that not only sheds new light on the design of Muon, but more importantly leads to a new optimizer. In the same spirit as the derivation of Newton's method, the surrogate approximates the loss as a quadratic function of the perturbation to a weight matrix $W$ using only three matrices: the gradient $G$, an output-space curvature matrix…
